headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 11, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers secured a crucial win over the Cleveland Guardians, while the Miami Marlins shut down the Pittsburgh Pirates in a 2-0 victory. The Chicago Cubs took down the Washington Nationals 8-6, and the New York Yankees defeated the Seattle Mariners 4-1.

Injuries and availability continue to impact teams, with several players being transferred to the 60-day injured list. Los Angeles Dodgers right-handed pitcher Blake Treinen has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation. Other notable injuries include Boston Red Sox second baseman Isiah Kiner-Falefa, New York Yankees right-handed pitcher Kervin Castro, Cincinnati Reds right-handed pitcher Hunter Greene, Toronto Blue Jays right-handed pitcher Jameson Taillon, Miami Marlins first baseman Kyle Stowers, San Francisco Giants catcher Daniel Susac, and Colorado Rockies right fielder Tyler Freeman.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place, with the Kansas City Royals acquiring first baseman Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. The Athletics acquired right-handed pitcher Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies, while the Phillies received right fielder Colby Thomas in return. The Miami Marlins traded right-handed pitcher Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for right-handed pitcher Brandan Bidois, left fielder Brian Sanchez, and infielder Hyun Seung Lee. The Colorado Rockies traded right-handed pitcher Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins for first baseman Connor Norby and right-handed pitcher Aiden May.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Guardians in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers edged out the Cleveland Guardians 6-4, securing a crucial win. Chase DeLauter led the Guardians' offense with 3 hits, including a home run, while Drew Anderson pitched 4 strong innings for Cleveland.

top_news.title: **Marlins Shut Down Pirates in 2-0 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a shutout win over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Eury Pérez pitching 7.0 innings of scoreless baseball, striking out 7 and walking 2. Esteury Ruiz led the Marlins' offense with a home run and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Cubs Take Down Nationals 8-6**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured an 8-6 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Seiya Suzuki leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. Jacob Webb earned the save with 1.1 scoreless innings, striking out 2 batters.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Mariners 4-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 4-1 victory over the Seattle Mariners, with Randy Arozarena leading the Mariners' offense with a home run and an RBI. Bryan Woo pitched 5 strong innings for the Mariners, striking out 5 batters and allowing no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Treinen Shifted to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Los Angeles Dodgers right-handed pitcher Blake Treinen has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have made a move to bolster their lineup, acquiring first baseman Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. The trade brings a new face to the Royals' roster as they continue their push in the 2026 season.
